verdict.reason: removable_wall_share_ceiling 0.5928632945308131 >= gate 0.05 in the measured cell (FLOW_sel1024_od): the candidate side (track + reset, 4791.0 ns median) replaces 48417.0 ns of median baseline kernel wall with bitwise-identical outputs, and even under the rigorous no-concurrency-model ceiling (kernel CPU exceeds the stage wall, forcing mean concurrency >= 3.014, so the wall saving is bounded by removable_kernel_share * stage_wall / window) the removable fraction is an order of magnitude above the gate.
